definition: A protective discourse or chant recited for blessing, safeguarding, and reassurance.

example_phrases.pali: Katā me rakkhā katā me parittā
example_phrases.translation: I have made my safeguard, I have made my protection
example_phrases.notes: AN 4.67's verse of protection, said after spreading friendliness to the four royal families of snakes.

notes: Citations corrected in the 2026-11-09 Wave 13 audit: the record cited Sn 1.8 (Karaṇīyamettā) and Khp 6 (Ratana), which are recited as protection texts but contain no form of `paritta`. AN 4.67 uses the word itself.
